About The Role
 In this role, you will contribute to the modernization and evolution of a highly customizable enterprise pricing platform that supports business-critical operations. Working across backend and frontend layers, you will develop new capabilities, enhance existing functionality, and help integrate the platform with external systems while collaborating with a distributed international team.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain full-stack features across a Java-based enterprise application, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability
Implement and customize business logic through Spring MVC components, Hibernate-based data access layers, and application-specific extension mechanisms to support Client requirements
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including architects, business stakeholders, QA engineers, and other developers, to deliver high-quality solutions and improve system capabilities
Develop and enhance user interfaces using JSP, Servlets, JavaScript, jQuery, and component libraries such as ag-Grid
Configure and extend XML-driven workflows, validations, UI components, and application behavior within a highly customizable framework
Build and maintain integrations with external platforms and third-party services using SOAP and REST APIs
Create and manage database schema changes, migrations, and data updates using Liquibase and relational database technologies
Contribute to troubleshooting, performance optimization, testing, and deployment activities across the application lifecycle
 Requirements
Strong commercial experience with Java and Java EE development
Hands-on experience with Spring Framework, including Spring MVC and dependency injection concepts
Solid expertise in Hibernate ORM, relational databases, and SQL development
Experience working with JSP, Servlets, and traditional server-side web applications
Strong understanding of XML-based configurations, workflow engines, and enterprise application customization patterns
Experience implementing event-driven extensions, hooks, or framework customization mechanisms within complex applications
Experience integrating external systems through SOAP and REST web services
Practical knowledge of Liquibase for database versioning and schema management
Familiarity with Maven, JUnit, Mockito, and application servers such as Tomcat
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment
Good communication skills and ability to contribute within distributed international teams
Intermediate French level for communication with the French-speaking team
Upper-intermediate English level
Proficiency in JavaScript and jQuery, and building interactive UI components and working with libraries such as ag-Grid (nice to have)
